readerCopy.headline: Send the email.
readerCopy.body:
The answer may be one message away. Someone is more receptive than you expected. An introduction leads to useful information. A proposal gets enough interest for a real follow-up. The opening is not abstract. There is an actual person, message, form, or conversation that can move it forward.

Jupiter sextile Mercury works when you use the line of communication that is already open. Ask the question. Send the application. Follow up after the meeting. A good idea does not need to stay private just because nobody has guessed you have it.
